text: That is He - O you polytheists - your Lord, Glorified and Exalted, there is no deity worthy of worship besides Him, the Creator of everything, so submit and humble yourselves to Him in obedience and worship. And He, Glorified be He, is over all things a Guardian and Keeper, managing the affairs of His creation.
